notes.notes:
Nodes Escape - On Sale Now!

Dear players,

We are excited to announce that "Text-based Escape Room" is now on sale!

This is our way of expressing gratitude for your ongoing support and love, allowing more players to experience the fun of our game.

Click here to get our game and enjoy this special discount!

[i]The Text-based Escape Room Team[/i]

notes.title: Nodes Escape - the Steam Workshop
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We are thrilled to announce that "Nodes Escape" has now joined the Steam Workshop!

This update will bring a whole new gaming experience. We have integrated a level editor into the game, allowing you to participate more deeply in the game creation process. Whether it's designing diverse puzzles or building exciting plots, you can turn your ideas into reality through the Workshop.

All you need to do is create your level in the game and then click publish, allowing players from all over the world to experience your creativity and imagination.

You can also play creations from other players here, feeling various quirky creativities and ideas.

We look forward to seeing your brilliant works and sincerely thank you for your support of "Text-based Escape Room" and your contribution to the community. If you encounter any problems while using the Workshop, or if you have any suggestions, please feel free to contact us through our QQ group at any time.

Happy creating!

[i]The Text-based Escape Room Team[/i]

notes.title: About the falsely reporting viruses and causing the game to fail
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44313219/9780da5ae6634d5c028a205d97d3f591fd989c6a.jpg[/img]This game is packaged by nw.js. Recently, it has been found that Windows Defender may falsely report viruses, and the startup files may be automatically deleted, resulting in the inability to open the game. [b] You can first bypass the false alarm by trusting the file[/b].

Related issues: [url=https://github.com/nwjs/nw.js/issues/8090]https://github.com/nwjs/nw.js/issues/8090[/url]

At present, the software has been submitted to [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/wdsi/filesubmission]Microsoft Security Inspection[/url], I don’t know if it is useful.

[img]https://peasy.soapphoto.com/d99894a5-6d4d-46d3-9085-41e377806a5e.jpg[/img]

Sorry to cause trouble to you, we are just ordinary indie game developers, we will not do those shameless things, please rest assured~

Finally, I sincerely thank you for your support (づ￣3￣)づ╭❤～

We will continue to update more interesting levels in the future~ (Creative workshop is researching, it will be a bit difficult, I guess it will not be too soon QAQ!)
